newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Japanese business leaders show confidence in HK.
newsitem.headline: Japanese business leaders show confidence in HK.

text.p: Japanese business leaders have confidence in Hong Kong's business prospects after the British colony reverts its rule to China in mid-1997, Hong Kong Trade Development Council (TDC) said on Wednesday.

All of the 40 senior Japanese executives who participated in the Japan/Hong Kong Business Co-operation Committee meeting in Tokyo said Hong Kong would continue to play a pivotal role in Asia's economic development, the TDC said in a statement.
It said they based their views on the continuance of Hong Kong's free port, low tax and fair regulatory policy which were enshrined in Hong Kong's future constitution, the Basic Law.
